game_concept: A action puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Palm Grove, a palm grove: the camel trader must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Palm Grove: a palm grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Palm Grove, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round, a new dates challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the bridge value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of dates by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Palm Grove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Palm Grove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 24 seconds.
